mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO business_operation_log (event_id, request_id, trace_id, user_id, username, source_service, module, function_name, operation_type, operation_name, trigger_type, operation_source, user_visible, business_key, success, alert_message, request_headers_json, method, path, client_ip, user_agent, occurred_at, completed_at, duration_ms) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{sourceService}, #{module}, #{functionName}, #{operationType}, #{operationName}, #{triggerType}, #{operationSource}, #{userVisible}, #{businessKey}, #{success}, #{alertMessage}, #{requestHeadersJson}, #{method}, #{path}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{occurredAt}, #{completedAt}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT IF(success = 1, 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM business_operation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND trigger_type = 'USER_ACTION' AND user_visible = 1 AND occurred_at >= #{since} GROUP BY success

SELECT function_name AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM business_operation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND trigger_type = 'USER_ACTION' AND user_visible = 1 AND occurred_at >= #{since} GROUP BY function_name ORDER BY value DESC
